dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: germinal-center B-cell (GCB) type by the Hans algorithm

stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IV, B symptoms present (Lugano stage IV-B)

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: extranodal lymphoma in the right kidney (3.2 cm), left adrenal (2.6 cm) and liver segment VI (1.8 cm)

stage_b_symptoms.quote: unintentional weight loss of about 10% (79 to 71 kg over two months, 70.2 kg on 2026-09-17) and drenching night sweats

prog_ipi_high.quote: IPI 5 of 5 (age >60, stage IV, LDH above ULN, ECOG 2, more than one extranodal site): high risk

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Start curative first-line immunochemotherapy: pola-R-CHP for six 21-day cycles

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not use DA-EPOCH-R or other intensification on this biology

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: Full dose, with no empiric reduction

cns_risk_addressed.quote: CNS-IPI is 6 of 6 (age >60, stage IV, LDH above ULN, ECOG >=2, more than one extranodal site, kidney and adrenal involvement), so his CNS relapse risk is high

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: diagnostic LP with cell count, cytology, flow cytometry, protein and glucose

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: I would revisit HD-MTX if renal function recovers to CrCl about 60 mL/min or more and he is clearly fit
cns_prophylaxis_renal.note: Ties HD-MTX to renal function but commits to IT MTX and does not frame benefit as uncertain.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT about 3 to 4 weeks after cycle 6, scored by Deauville and Lugano 2014

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4 to 5 with residual mass: biopsy when it would change management

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: repeat urate, potassium, phosphate, calcium and creatinine every 6 to 8 hours for the first 24 to 48 hours
sup_tls_prophylaxis.note: Frequent labs and rasburicase, but monitoring window 24-48 h not 72 h and hydration 'oral or IV'.

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: Rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg IV once before cycle 1 if G6PD is normal

sup_gcsf.quote: pegfilgrastim every cycle, using the on-body injector applied on day 1

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen now and do not restart any NSAID

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: Steroid hyperglycemia on prednisone days 1 to 5: home glucose checks before meals and at bedtime

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg and anti-HBc nonreactive, anti-HBs reactive (vaccine immunity), so no HBV antiviral prophylaxis is needed

work_echo_reviewed.quote: He is ECOG 2 but independent in self-care, LVEF is 60%, and there is no organ failure that limits dosing
work_echo_reviewed.note: LVEF 60% cited as supporting full-dose therapy rather than explicitly anthracycline eligibility.

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: ECOG 2 with self-care is acceptable for full-dose therapy
fit_ecog_disease_related.note: Does not explicitly attribute ECOG 2 to disease, though proceeds with full-dose curative therapy and notes goal of cure.
